WITH supplier_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        i.seller_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS shipment_count
    FROM invoices i
    JOIN shipments s ON i.shipment_id = s.id
    GROUP BY i.seller_name
)
SELECT 
    seller_name,
    shipment_count
FROM supplier_counts
ORDER BY shipment_count DESC, seller_name ASC
LIMIT 1
output.explanation: Returns the supplier with the highest number of distinct shipments, ordered by shipment count descending.
